settings.heading: Product Specifications
settings.content:
Customizable Modular Shelving : Innovative cube design allows for a staggered, step-style or straight configuration; Includes 6 open cubes stack, arrange to fit your space and for storing books, clothes, shoes, toys, décor, and more. A perfect space-saving solution for any room.

Durable Construction: Made with strong galvanized steel pipes and high-quality non-woven fabric panels to hold your items securely and reinforced double tube brackets for reliable support last long.

Quality Connectors: High-quality plastic connectors provide strong joins and make assembly/disassembly easy and tool-free.

Lightweight & Portable: Easy to move and reconfigure. The lightweight frame makes it simple to adapt or relocate as storage needs change.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
Materials: 

Shelves made from coated, water-resistant non-woven fabric for easy cleaning; frame crafted from galvanized steel tubes for sturdiness; durable plastic connectors for stability.

Care Instructions:

  • Wipe clean with a damp cloth as needed to remove dust or spills.
  • Avoid overloading shelves or storing heavy objects that exceed individual cube weight limits.
  • Keep away from direct moisture and prolonged sunlight to maintain strength and color.
  • Disassemble and reassemble as necessary for relocation—parts are reusable and portable.
